questions.question: If a motorcycle is towing a trailer, how should the following distance change?
questions.explanation: A motorcycle towing a trailer needs a longer following distance. The trailer adds weight, so the motorcycle takes longer to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. Warning signs are yellow with black symbols. This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is coming.

questions.question: What color are service signs?
questions.explanation: Service signs are blue with white letters. They show where to find gas stations, food, rest areas, and hospitals.

questions.question: How much of a motorcycle's stopping power comes from the front brake?
questions.explanation: The front brake is more powerful than the rear brake. It provides about three-quarters of the motorcycle's total stopping power.

questions.question: When preparing to ride with a passenger, what should you tell them to do?

options.text: Get on the motorcycle before you do.
Sit as far back as possible.
Hold firmly onto your waist, hips, or belt.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hold firmly onto your waist, hips, or belt.
questions.explanation: Tell your passenger to hold firmly onto your waist, hips, or belt. They should sit as far forward as comfortable and get on after you start the engine.

questions.question: How do you shift to a higher gear?

options.text: Place your foot under the shift lever and lift.
Place your foot over the shift lever and push.
Use your thumb to move the lever.

questions.correctAnswerText: Place your foot under the shift lever and lift.
questions.explanation: To shift to a higher gear, put your foot under the shift lever and lift.

questions.question: What does the SEE strategy stand for?
questions.explanation: The Motorcycle Safety Foundation recommends the SEE strategy. SEE stands for Search, Evaluate, and Execute. This helps riders make safe choices while riding.

questions.question: What should motorcyclists do about the oily strip in the center of a traffic lane?

options.text: Find the lane with the least oil buildup.

questions.explanation: Avoid riding on the oily strip. It is usually narrow enough that you can ride on the left or right side of the lane and still stay in the center portion.

questions.question: How can you become sober after drinking alcohol?
questions.explanation: The only way to become sober is to give your body time to process the alcohol. Nothing else can speed up this process.

questions.question: Where should inexperienced riders position themselves when riding in a group?

options.text: At the front leading the group.
Near the front of the group.
At the back of the group.

questions.correctAnswerText: Near the front of the group.
questions.explanation: Less experienced riders should be near the front, right behind the leader. This way, experienced riders can lead and watch the newer riders at the same time.

questions.question: When sitting on a motorcycle, how should you position yourself?

options.text: Use your arms to hold up your body.
Sit at an angle so your arms can support your weight.
Sit so you can use your arms to control the motorcycle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sit so you can use your arms to control the motorcycle.
questions.explanation: Sit with good posture so your arms can control the motorcycle. Do not position yourself so your arms have to hold up your body weight.

questions.question: Where do most motorcycle and car accidents happen?
questions.explanation: Most motorcycle and car accidents happen at intersections. Usually, the car driver fails to give the right-of-way to the motorcycle rider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is on the back of slow-moving vehicles that travel slower than 25 mph. Examples include farm equipment, construction vehicles, and horse-drawn wagons.

questions.question: What is the most important thing for a helmet to do to protect you?
questions.explanation: Your helmet will protect you best if it fits snugly all the way around and meets DOT standards. It should have no cracks or damage.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drivers must come to a complete stop.
Drivers may proceed through the intersection with caution.
Drivers must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: A solid red arrow means the same as a red light. You must stop completely and wait for a signal that allows you to turn in your direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Vehicles will be entering the roadway.
Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe to do so.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: Red octagonal signs are always stop signs. You must stop completely, check for other traffic and pedestrians, then proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: When riding in a group, how should riders use their mirrors?

options.text: Should be checked frequently by all riders.
Should be used only by the lead rider.
Should not be checked frequently because they can be a distraction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should be checked frequently by all riders.
questions.explanation: All riders should check their mirrors often to see the riders behind them and make sure the group stays together.

questions.question: When riding a motorcycle, where should your feet be?

options.text: Pointed with your toes aiming downward.

questions.explanation: Keep your feet firmly on the footrests for balance. Do not point your toes downward, as they may get caught between the road and the footrests.

questions.question: What lane space are motorcyclists entitled to?

options.text: Must share a lane if traffic is congested.
Are entitled to use a full lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are entitled to use a full lane.
questions.explanation: Motorcyclists have the right to use a full traffic lane. Sharing a lane is usually unsafe and not allowed.

questions.question: When should you inspect your motorcycle for safety?
questions.explanation: Always inspect your motorcycle before each ride. Small problems on a motorcycle are more dangerous than small problems on a car.

questions.question: In California, it is illegal to ride a motorcycle with a blood alcohol content (BAC) of:
questions.explanation: In California, riders age 21 or older cannot ride with a BAC of 0.08 percent or higher. Riders under 21 cannot ride with a BAC of 0.01 percent or higher. Riding with any alcohol is unsafe.

questions.question: What is the best position to ride in within a lane?

options.text: There is no single best lane position.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is no single best lane position.
questions.explanation: No single lane position is always best. Good riders change their position as traffic and road conditions change.

questions.question: When approaching a blind intersection, what should riders do?

options.text: Stop at the stop line, then move forward slowly to see cross traffic better.
Ignore the stop line and move forward to get a better view.
Stop at the stop line and proceed through the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop at the stop line, then move forward slowly to see cross traffic better.
questions.explanation: Stop at the stop line first. Then edge forward and stop again just before the crossroad. Lean forward to look around buildings, parked cars, or bushes. Keep your front wheel out of the crossroad while looking.

questions.question: Why should a rider change gears before starting a turn?

options.text: To prevent sudden power changes during the turn.
To keep both hands on the handlebars during the turn.
To prevent the motorcycle from slowing down.

questions.correctAnswerText: To prevent sudden power changes during the turn.
questions.explanation: Change gears before you turn. Shifting gears during a turn can cause the rear wheel to suddenly gain or lose power, which may cause a skid. If you must shift while turning, do it smoothly.

questions.question: Riders are usually most visible to other drivers when riding in which lane position?
questions.explanation: The center lane position is usually best because it places you in the driver's rearview mirror. Always be ready to change positions if traffic or road conditions require it.
